requirement_statements: This newly proposed task asks whether the original file persistence writer and cache lookup preserve their base-version URI-to-file mapping, including empty or root paths, nested paths and directory-ending URI paths.

The candidate implementation should maintain compatible basename encoding and path separator behavior across the pre-fix writer and reader interfaces without relying on post-fix source or copied PR-authored expected outputs.
Correct behavior should preserve separation of cache identities by spider identifier and preserve the original base-version cache freshness semantics for missing, fresh and expired resources.
The candidate should preserve the documented and observable supported protected naming extension behavior, subject to independent approval of the applicable PHP subclass contract.

An independent evaluator should assess actual serialized write-to-cache-read interoperability and a separately constructed legacy fixture; neither evaluator outputs nor oracle source may be included in the public task specification.

This is a new prospective review proposal derived from read-only base-source observations, NOT a reconstruction of the originally filed issue text, NOT a complete independently ratified behavior specification, and NOT an admitted full-repository experiment.
